Brightline Software is hiring a Junior Software Engineer to join our platform team. In this role you'll fix bugs in our production codebase, write unit tests for new features, and participate in code review with senior engineers. We're looking for a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, along with proficiency in at least one object-oriented language such as Java, Python, or C++. An internship or coursework in web development is a plus. You should be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
